## Snow Roc (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
N Gargantuan animal  
**Init** +6; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +16  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 8, flat-footed 19 (+2 Dex, +15  natural, –4 size)  
**hp** 154 (14d8+42)  
**Fort** +12, **Ref** +13, **Will** +7; **Resist** cold 15  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., fly 80 ft. (average)  
**Melee** 2 talons +16 (2d6+9 plus grab, Crit 19-20/x2), bite +10 (2d8+4)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft.  
**Special Attacks** icy gust (30-ft. cone, 7d6 cold, DC 20 Reflex negates)  

**Tactics**

 **During Combat** Snow rocs use Flyby Attack in conjunction with icy gust to debilitate foes.  

 **Morale** Snow rocs are highly territorial but flee when reduced to 15 hp or less.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 28, **Dex** 15, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** 23; **CMD** 35  
**Feats** Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (talons), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Focus (talon)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (talon).*  
**Skills** Fly +9, Perception +16; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception  

**Special Abilities**

 **Icy Gust (Su)** As a free action once every 1d4 rounds, a snow roc can launch a blast of cold from its wings in a 30-ft. cone dealing 7d6 cold damage to all creatures in the affected area (DC 20 Reflex negates).  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any cold or arctic mountains  
**Organization** solitary or mated pair  
**Treasure** none
